sn11.5:1.11: “Elder god” is _pubbadeva_. Taittirīya Brāhmaṇa 3.2.9e explains that originally the earth belonged to the titans. This battle by debate recalls Bṛhadāraṇyaka Upaniṣad 1.3.1, which explains that the titans are the elder children of Pajāpati. The younger children, the gods, sought to overcome them by means of reciting the sacred word (_udgītha_), but the titans pierced it with the evil that is bad speech.
